title: Hello at the Coffee Shop
subtitle: Basic greetings and ordering — for English learners

sentences.en: Hi! Good morning. How are you today?
sentences.target: Hi! Good morning. How are you today?

sentences.en: I'm good, thanks. Can I have a small coffee, please?
sentences.target: I'm good, thanks. Can I have a small coffee, please?

sentences.en: Sure. Would you like milk or sugar with that?
sentences.target: Sure. Would you like milk or sugar with that?

sentences.en: That will be three dollars and fifty cents.
sentences.target: That will be three dollars and fifty cents.

sentences.en: Here you go. Can I pay with a card?
sentences.target: Here you go. Can I pay with a card?

sentences.en: Yes, the card reader is right here. Tap or insert.
sentences.target: Yes, the card reader is right here. Tap or insert.

sentences.en: Thank you. Have a nice day!
sentences.target: Thank you. Have a nice day!

sentences.en: You too. See you next time!
sentences.target: You too. See you next time!
